adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController, `before_filter :ensure_embeddable` runs before `best`, and `ensure_embeddable` raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess` when `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` (default in `config/site_settings.yml` is `''`). Therefore the spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url"` (`get :best`) can fail/succeed due to the missing/blank `embeddable_host` (and/or missing referer) before `params.require(:embed_url)` is evaluated, so it doesn't actually verify missing-param handling and could pass even if that logic were removed.
